_doc: Copy of the builders wall, one entry per README language (keys = LOCALES in builders-core.mjs). Placeholders: {since} month of the first arrival, {week} people in the last 7 days, {ago} time since the latest arrival (Intl, localized), {n} people shown, {month} month during the build. captionQuiet replaces caption when fewer than WEEK_MIN people joined in the last 7 days. A language missing here is not rendered and the route serves English. en: narrative-ops + venture-ops, 17-oct-2026. Never translate: career-ops, CareerOps, GitHub; 'A room, not a club' / 'the door is open' take the wording that README already uses.

en.title: Built in the open, one person at a time
en.caption: Since {since} · {week} joined this week · the door is open
en.captionQuiet: Since {since} · latest arrival {ago} · the door is open
en.alt: Animated wall of contributors' GitHub avatars, filling in order of arrival since {since}, with the next square left open.
